process.A.name: Payment confirmation
process.A.description: A payment confirmation is read in and matched against the open invoices. Once a person confirms it, the payment is posted: the invoice counts as paid.
process.A.process_end: The invoice is posted as paid
process.B.name: Incoming invoice
process.B.description: An incoming invoice is read in and assigned by the cost centre named on the document. It is then archived in an audit-proof way. No payment is posted here.
process.B.process_end: The invoice is archived in an audit-proof way

agent.reader.name: Reader tool
agent.reader.description: PDF -> Markdown. Not an AI agent. Access only for members of the AD security group (Least Privilege).
agent.orchestrator.name: Orchestrator agent
agent.orchestrator.description: Routes by document type and steers the workflow.
agent.klassifikation.name: Document-type router
agent.klassifikation.description: Determines only the document type and selects the matching process.
agent.extraktion_zahlung.name: Payment extraction agent
agent.extraktion_zahlung.description: Extracts the invoice or order number and amount from a payment confirmation.
agent.extraktion_rechnung.name: Invoice extraction agent
agent.extraktion_rechnung.description: Extracts invoice number, amount, supplier, line items and cost-centre reference.
agent.abgleich.name: Reconciliation agent
agent.abgleich.description: Matches the extracted invoice/order number exactly against the master data (deterministic). Read access only.
agent.buchung.name: Booking agent
agent.buchung.description: Posts the payment in the ERP, status open -> paid. Financially effective, therefore always subject to approval (human-in-the-loop).
agent.kostenstelle.name: Cost centre agent
agent.kostenstelle.description: Looks the document's cost-centre reference up exactly in the catalogue (deterministic). If it is missing, four-eyes approval applies.
agent.elo.name: ELO agent
agent.elo.description: Archives the invoice in the DMS in an audit-proof way. End of process B (diagram part 3).
agent.policy.name: Policy/governance component
agent.audit.name: Audit/monitoring component
